fixed_totals_axis.rule: The TOTALS parameters are fixed and may not be refit or changed by this task.

candidate.name: conditional_goal_share_logit.v1
candidate.fit_objective: sum over fixtures of n_goals * log(1 + exp(eta)) - home_goals * eta; zero-goal fixtures contribute zero; this is the conditional binomial share NLL and is the share-dependent term of independent-Poisson scoreline NLL when total lambda is fixed

optimizer.method: deterministic Newton-Raphson on the convex two-parameter objective
optimizer.failure: reject; do not switch optimizer, restart, clip the fitted parameters, or redesign after viewing metrics

candidate.outside_bounds: reject; do not clip or refit

comparators.totals_only: fixed accepted TOTALS axis with the current linear delta allocation
comparators.candidate: fixed accepted TOTALS axis plus conditional_goal_share_logit.v1

oof.method: expanding prefix strictly before each validation fold

scoring.line_weighting: equal within AH; one fixture is one paired-bootstrap unit
scoring.scoreline_support: independent Poisson score matrix on goals 0 through 12 inclusive, normalized exactly as the previous frozen market-axis evaluator
